data.gender_notes: Fokrul is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is the ruler of the night and the guardian of the moon. The name Fokrul carries the meaning “Moon God” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Bengali. Parents who choose Fokrul usually hope their child will grow to embody moon god and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fokrul total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Fokrul" holds a rich cultural significance in Hinduism, as it is the name of a fierce Yaksha or nature spirit who is believed to be the lord of the night and the guardian of the moon. Fokrul is often depicted as a warrior riding on a horse or elephant, carrying a weapon and adorned with moon-shaped ornaments, symbolizing his connection to the lunar cycle. He is believed to have the power to control natural elements such as water, wind, and light, and is invoked for protection, prosperity, and fertility. In many Hindu traditions, ceremonies and rituals related to agriculture, harvesting, and trade invoke Fokrul's blessings for a successful yield and prosperity.
data.spiritual_significance: According to Hindu philosophy, Fokrul represents the manifestation of the divine energy of the universe that governs the natural cycles and roles of life. As the guardian of the moon, Fokrul is believed to embody the feminine, nurturing aspects of the divine, including creation, sustenance, and transformation. His fierce and protective nature reflects the powerful, unchanging aspects of the divine, reminding us of the cyclical nature of life and the importance of balance and harmony in our physical and spiritual existence. Invoking Fokrul's blessings can help us connect with the spiritual power of the natural world, and tap into our own inner strength and resilience in the face of obstacles and challenges.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Fokrul is a Hindu name derived from the Bengali language. It is believed to mean "Blessed by Allah" or "Protected by God." The name is a reminder of the divine grace and protection that is ever-present in one's life.
